test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

Some books are notes.

All notes are copies.

Conclusions:

(I) Some books are copies.

(II) No books is copies.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b82bacd8c192489162bb207d0fead66e98f96e9f5cb86fc5763b1c01949e3dc.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some books are copies → **True **(As, Some books are notes, All notes are copies. so, Some books are copies holds true)

(II) No books is copies → False (As, Some books are notes, All notes are copies. so, No books is copies is false)

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
